about: Sanitized regression contracts for bad cases reported by the site owner. An AQ id preserves trajectory provenance when available; older screenshot-only reports use a REPORTED id. Raw trajectories stay in Cloudflare and are not committed. Offline tests check deterministic routing, retrieval scope, and resource delivery. The live eval also checks model answers.

cases.title: A resume reply rendered a broken prose link and a duplicate attachment
cases.regression: The model wrote a malformed resume URL in prose while the frontend also rendered the same PDF as a resource card.

cases.title: A token question returned a dashboard link and repeated the resume
cases.regression: The answer described where token data lived instead of returning the live number, then leaked the prior turn's resume card into the response.

cases.title: A broad project question attached five unrelated links
cases.regression: Generic words such as project matched unrelated catalogue items, so the answer showed token, Kaboo, projects and Lark Loom cards together.
